performance.verdict: CPL efficiency strong, but zero GHL appointments exposes a deep intake gap.

findings.text: OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — leads cannot be traced to patients in the chair.
OVERDUE: Renewal closed 2026-07-23 — 1-month prove-it window is already 26 days in with 0 GHL won opportunities and 0 appointments logged.
CPL efficiency improved: 28-day CPL $11.90, down 26% week-over-week. Spend dropped 32.93% but leads fell only 9.37% — Meta is spending more efficiently, not collapsing.

3-day signal (Aug 15–17): leads 1, 3, 8 vs prior 3 days (Aug 12–14): 8, 4, 1 — volatile, not trending down. Spend compressed to $18.51/$41.10/$34.85 vs $64.90/$42.59/$21.11. Low spend days driving low lead days.
GHL shows 81 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and 255 contacts vs 122 ad leads — 133-contact overhang suggests intake process is not converting leads to scheduled visits.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap immediately — every unattributed call is invisible on the August scoreboard.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) is unresolved and the sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) is also open. With 0 won opportunities and 0 appointments in GHL over 28 days, the client's scoreboard — leads to scheduled patients to production — cannot be read. Complete both tasks this week. Success check: at least one inbound call or lead is traceable end-to-end from ad source to GHL contact by 2026-08-21.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake pipeline: 81 opportunities created, 0 converted — confirm Lily/new hire are working leads within 24 hours.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 81 opportunities created and 0 won over the 28-day window, with 255 total contacts against only 122 ad-sourced leads. This is not an ads problem — it is an intake process gap. Confirm with Lily and the new intake hire that leads are being contacted within 24 hours and moved to 'Appointment Booked' stage. Success check: at least 5 opportunities advanced to a booked stage by 2026-08-25, which would begin to populate the August scoreboard before month-end.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta daily spend: 3-day avg $31.49 vs mid-month avg ~$60 — confirm budget is not unintentionally suppressed before scaling.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend over Aug 15–17 averaged $31.49/day against a mid-month average near $60/day, with CPL holding strong at $11.90 over 28 days. Before any budget increase, verify that the daily budget setting has not been manually reduced or that delivery is not being suppressed by learning-phase issues. Re-check on 2026-08-21: if spend has recovered toward $50–60/day and CPL remains below $15, a modest +15–20% budget increase on BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness would be defensible.
